text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! The time has finally come,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's been working so hard and
now's the
big pay off! It's time to go
head-to-head!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I can only imagine how intense it's gonna
be!
Ooh, I can barely contain my
excitement!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Do you mind hopping on my
shoulders
while I do some squats?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're right! The best use for all this
pent-up
energy is...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To let it out during the race! I'm going
all out!
